facts.detail: Ofcom published the Nations report 2025 on 19 November 2025.
The report states that full fibre was available to 79% of residential premises in England.
Gigabit-capable coverage in England reached 88%, or 21.1 million premises.
Where full fibre was available in England, take-up reached 41%, eight percentage points higher than the previous year.
Satellite broadband customer connections in England increased from around 70,000 to 90,000.

guard_streams.source: Latest home broadband performance trends revealed

facts.detail: Ofcom's research uses performance measurements delivered to customer routers and data from the four largest UK broadband providers.
Average full-fibre download speed increased by 1.9 Mbit/s, or 1%, to 149.2 Mbit/s.
The average 8–10pm peak-time speed was 67.7 Mbit/s, equal to 95% of the 71.0 Mbit/s average maximum.
The average daily minimum speed was 63.3 Mbit/s, equal to 89% of the average maximum.
The reported effect of busy-period network congestion was lowest for full-fibre lines.

facts.detail: Ofcom's 3G and 2G switch-off page was last updated on 29 May 2026.
UK mobile operators have told government they do not intend to offer 2G or 3G services beyond 2033 at the latest.
The retirement of legacy networks supports rollout of faster and more reliable 4G and 5G services.
The UK Government published a voluntary 2G switch-off charter in March 2026.
Ofcom sets expectations for providers to identify and support customers affected by legacy-network retirement.

facts.detail: Ofcom's Planned Network Deployment collection was last updated on 13 May 2026.
The latest report examines anticipated very-high-capacity network coverage through the end of 2028.
The analysis is based on network operators' stated deployment plans as of January 2026 over the following three years.
The plans include privately funded builds and operator plans supported through public funding or intervention.
The report excludes separate national or local public-authority rollout aspirations that are not operator deployment plans.

facts.detail: Ofcom published the Planned Network Deployments 2026 report on 13 May 2026.
If all plans are realised, full fibre could reach 28.1 million UK homes, or 92%, by January 2029.
Gigabit-capable coverage could reach 29 million homes, or 95%, by January 2029.
Planned gigabit coverage could reach 97% in urban areas and 86% in rural areas by January 2029.
Operators reported around 6,950 additional geographically distinct FWA masts planned or due for upgrade between January 2026 and January 2029.
